seo.title: JUBA - HOMELESS HELP - No Home Help
seo.description: Verified emergency, shelter, food, health, safety, legal and social-support contacts for people facing homelessness in Juba.

page.heading: JUBA - HOMELESS HELP
page.urgent: If someone is in immediate danger, contact the local emergency services listed below. Conflict, weather and local conditions can disrupt services.
page.notice: Information, hours, eligibility and availability can change. Call before travelling when possible. A listing does not guarantee a bed, meal, appointment, benefit, treatment or job.
page.intro: Start with the most relevant service below and explain that you are in Juba, whether you have a safe place tonight, and any medical, safety, disability or child-protection needs.
page.footer: Sources are linked in every entry. Services were described conservatively; no accommodation is presented as guaranteed unless the provider publishes it.

entries.title: UNHCR general contact
entries.description: UNHCR general contact provides or coordinates shelter and housing support in or for Juba. Contact the service directly to confirm eligibility, location and current availability. Help depends on status, vulnerability and current operations; accommodation is not guaranteed.
entries.how_to_access: Call or use the official website before travelling. Ask specifically what help is available today and whether a referral or documents are required.
